meta.name: ai-observability-langfuse
meta.description: LLM observability with Langfuse — OpenTelemetry-based tracing, evaluations, prompt management, datasets, and production best practices

copy.tagline: 追踪和分析LLM应用的生产表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建或维护LLM应用并需要生产级可观测性。
copy.tagline_en: Trace and analyze LLM application performance in production
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or maintaining LLM applications and need production-grade observability.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动追踪 LLM 应用的调用链、记录 token 消耗和成本，并管理提示词模板、评估输出质量。
howto.when: 当你在代码中引入 Langfuse SDK 并调用追踪函数（如 startActiveObservation）或使用 observeOpenAI 包装 OpenAI 客户端时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Langfuse 追踪这个 OpenAI 调用。
为这个 LLM 应用添加嵌套追踪。
用 Langfuse 管理提示词模板并编译变量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically trace LLM application calls, record token usage and costs, manage prompt templates, and evaluate output quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you import Langfuse SDK and call tracing functions like startActiveObservation or use observeOpenAI to wrap the OpenAI client.

say_en.text: Help me trace this OpenAI call with Langfuse.
Add nested tracing for this LLM application.
say_en.note: Claude will use startActiveObservation to create parent-child observations.

say_en.text: Manage prompt templates with Langfuse and compile variables.
say_en.note: Claude will use LangfuseClient to fetch and compile prompts.
